title: Spatial evolution of a cachexia-promoting microenvironment in pancreatic cancer.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC record (PMID 42810340): not open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no text-mined accessions. NCBI elink from PubMed returned only related-PubMed links, no GEO/SRA/BioProject. One web search found only press coverage, no data deposit. Affiliation includes Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, Beijing.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the data (single-cell RNA sequencing, Xenium spatial transcriptomics, multiplex immunohistochemistry, bulk transcriptomics across non-cachexia, pre-cachexia and cachexia patients) comes from the abstract only. Patient counts, cell counts and the deposit location were not visible.

a1_downloadable.note: No public accession found in Europe PMC, NCBI links or web search; full text is paywalled. Human patient sequencing from a Chinese hospital is typically deposited in GSA-Human (Genome Sequence Archive for human data), which requires an access application. Not verified either way.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked. The cachexia stage (non/pre/cachexia) is a per-patient clinical label that would have to be joined from clinical metadata to cells or spatial spots.

a5_enough_rows.note: Patient count unknown; the honest unit for predicting cachexia is the patient, likely tens, far below 400.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Xenium plus single-cell data are often multi-GB; not checked.

a8_label_provenance.note: Cachexia status is a clinical assessment (weight loss criteria), a real measurement, per the abstract.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) would be the candidates
backbone.hardware: CPU for embeddings of a subset

honest_claim_h3: Not reachable: without downloadable data, no claim can be made.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use tumour single-cell and spatial gene expression to predict whether a pancreatic cancer patient has or will develop cachexia (wasting).
plain_idea.train_on: Per-patient summaries of cell types and spatial neighbourhoods from tumour samples; number of patients unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Cachexia stage (none, pre-cachexia, cachexia) or later development of cachexia, from clinical weight-loss assessment.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Oncologists could flag patients at risk of wasting before weight loss starts, but only if the data were accessible and patients numerous.

ml_idea: Patient-level cachexia-stage classifier from niche abundance (SEMA4A+ tumour, AQP9+ macrophage, LOXL2+ fibroblast) in spatial data; blocked by data access and patient count.

effort.compute_note: Nothing estimated; no data files located.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Find the data availability statement's accession and whether it is open (GEO) or controlled (GSA-Human); then count patients per cachexia stage.

verdict_reason: No public data found (paywalled paper, no accessions in Europe PMC or NCBI); likely controlled-access human data, and the patient-level sample is probably tens, failing A1 and A5.
